mostWorthwhile.text: Adding sugar was most worthwhile because the result connected the assembled cell machinery to ATP production and showed that some ATP is made outside mitochondria.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the rear tendons felt least engaging because it closely followed the front tendon combination and was the only available choice.

surprise.text: I learned that sugar processing in the watery cell interior makes some ATP before mitochondria use the partly processed fuel.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked a clear purpose, though choosing front tendons before rear tendons was arbitrary because both seemed equally useful.

continue.text: I would be somewhat interested in continuing to see how the opposing muscles attach to a framework, although I would hope for more meaningful choices.
